snippet.title: Step 'N Smush | Micro May Playtest Update Gameplay
snippet.description:
The latest Step 'N Smush Playtest Update for Micro May is now live!

You can play it for FREE over at itch.io!

The game is still in development, so expect to see future updates. We will do our best to keep you posted.

Happy Shrinking those Micros! X3
